source: NOAA ETOPO2022 15 arcsecond terrain; not observed rivers
fineInformation: Every fine node is an actual raw source DEM value. Coarse values are nested decimations. Interpolation is only the no-new-information control.
cropRule: Five predetermined65x65 samples: four domain corners and center; equal physical extents; overlapping crops are not independent samples
experimentalPatch: refine-regional-water-gap8 changes maximum validation factor4 to8 only; official module unchanged
reference: Direct routing on actual fine DEM using identical inherited endpoint positions, levels and source supplies per factor. Independent all-open fine DEM and full121-domain routes provide boundary sensitivity.
limits: Reference rivers are solver-calculated terrain routing, not observed hydrography.
Five overlapping crops from one small domain are not independent or global validation.
Decimation is a controlled parent representation; coarse-scale aggregation choice not tested.
Runtime and heap delta are single-process diagnostic measurements, not statistically stable performance limits.
Coarse/fine adjacent gap8 may erase valleys; exact parent preservation does not establish realism.
Boundary outlet spacing changes with factor; sparseOutletEffect separates this confound from same-endpoint method comparisons.
